blocks.text: WASHINGTON D.C., United States—TikTok on Friday agreed to pay Alabama at least $100 million and enact time limits and other restrictions for teen users. As a result, it avoided trial with a settlement modeled on Instagram-owner Meta’s recent agreement with US states. A trial had been set to begin Monday in the southern US state over claims by Alabama that TikTok misled parents about tools meant to shield children from harmful content.
